title: LeNet-5
description: The classic convolutional digit classifier: two 5×5 convolution and 2×2 average-pooling stages, then 120- and 84-unit tanh layers. The final width is inferred from the output contract.
reference: LeCun et al., "Gradient-Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition" (Proc. IEEE, 1998), in the usual modern reading with fully connected C5/F6 layers; checked against the equivalent torch.nn stack: 156 + 2,416 + 48,120 + 10,164 + 850 = 61,706 parameters.
